books.title: The First Chain
books.author: Covenant Press
lore_pages: The first walls were not raised against men. They were raised against forgetting. When the Falling Fire ended, survivors wandered beneath a sky full of ash and called every direction home.
Saint Orun ordered the roads measured and the passes watched. He named vigilance the First Chain, because a people that cannot hold a boundary cannot preserve a law.
Ashen Gate keeps that charge. Its wardens are taught that every road has two duties: to carry the faithful inward, and to turn the Unmoored away.

books.title: Watchman's Rule
books.author: Gate Captain's Office
lore_pages: Stand where stone meets road. Watch the horizon before you watch the traveler. The heretic announces himself first by haste, noise, smoke, or the unnatural shadow of a wing.
Do not pursue a sky-machine beyond the range of the guns. Mark its direction. Ring twice for a sighting, three times for descent, and without pause if it turns toward a sacred house.
Remember: the wall is not cowardice. A wall is the earth made vertical, still rooted, still bearing weight. There is honor in standing behind what cannot fly.

books.title: Letter from Ashen Gate
books.author: Brother Teren
lore_pages: Mother, the Gate is colder than the stories said. At dawn the towers are red with light, and the valley below looks so deep that I understand why the old builders feared empty air.
They tell us the Unmoored worship a spirit that calls them upward. I have never heard it. I only hear the stone beneath my boots and the bell that says we are still here.
If my service ends before winter, place my name in the family cairn. I would rather return beneath our field than be burned and scattered like the first flyers.

books.title: Ashen Gate Supply Ledger
books.author: Quartermaster's Hand
lore_pages: Four carts of grain. Two crates of bolts. Lamp oil, nine jars. Oxblood cloth, six rolls. Brass fittings for the west battery, three bundles.
The Gate consumes more timber each month because patrols range farther. Orders from the High Seat say no road is to be abandoned while an Unmoored settlement can reach it.
A note in the margin: courier measures are to remain divided. No common messenger carries all three marks to any strategic house.

books.title: Seal I — The Hidden Seat
books.author: Ashen Gate Command
lore_pages: Common charts end where the old frontier once ended, but the Covenant did not. After the road wars, the High Seat was deliberately removed from ordinary maps.
Vespera is not a myth and not a metaphor. The city exists beyond the marches, built where the mountain itself forms the final wall.
This sealed copy carries one of the official measures of the Rooted Crown. It was never meant for a common patrol.
